officialSources.observation: Official Khammam district page states that the District Survey & Land Records office maintains government and patta land records, survey/subdivision work, and town-survey records are maintained in the municipal office.
Official Telangana Bhu Bharati GIS page exposes district/division/mandal/village selectors and map parcel-information controls.
Official Telangana Remote Sensing Applications Centre Web GIS catalogue links Bhu Bharathi and Bhunaksha services.

Official ArcGIS REST metadata identifies a polygon Feature Layer named Cadastral Parcels, with projected WGS 1984 Lambert Conformal Conic metadata and fields including OBJECTID, OBJECTID_1, Feature_Co and Parcel_num.

requests.outcome: Official district Survey & Land Records page loaded; no parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
The viewer route was attempted anonymously. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, or private token was used; no feature response was obtained.
Official TGRAC Web GIS catalogue loaded and exposed the Bhu Bharathi/Bhunaksha routes.
Layer metadata loaded. It is a polygon Cadastral Parcels layer; schema and projected CRS were recorded, but no Khammam applicability or feature identity was established from metadata alone.
Response was valid ArcGIS JSON with polygon geometry type and an empty features array. This exact-point zero result is not treated as evidence of citywide absence, and no geometry was retained.
